newsitem.title: USA: PP&L to acquire Penn Fuel Gas.
newsitem.headline: PP&L to acquire Penn Fuel Gas.

text.p: Electric utility PP&L Resources Inc. said Friday it has agreed to acquire privately held Penn Fuel Gas Inc. for about $121 million in stock.
Under the definitive agreement, PP&L will offer 7.665 of its common shares for each Penn Fuel Gas common share.
Penn Fuel Gas, based in Oxford, Pa., distributes and stores natural gas and sells propane. The company has nearly 100,000 customers in Pennsylvania and a few hundred in Maryland.

"As the electricity, natural gas and other markets develop, we are preparing to offer a full range of energy sources to our customers and to develop our customer base," William Hecht, chairman of PPL said in a statement.
PP&L Resources, based in Allentown, Pa., said it has received a commitment that a block of nearly 95 percent of Penn Fuel Gas's shares will be voted in favour of the merger.
The acquisition is expected to close in about 12 months, subject to regulatory approvals. The deal has been approved by the boards of directors of the companies.
PP&L Resources' primary subsidiary is Pennsylvania Power & Light Co., which provides electricity services to 1.2 million customers in central and eastern Pennsylvania.
Penn Fuel Gas earned $7.4 million on revenues of $113.5 million in 1996.
Penn Fuel Gas' stock was unchanged at $19.875 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
